title: A real connect, as logged (Claude Code and Codex)
lede: What the connector's log showed when Claude Code and Codex connected. Each box is a status the connector actually returned.

lanes.label: Measured on 2026-10-30; the last box is where the points balance stopped

nodes.label: 2. Agent registers
sub: 201, DCR, auth method none, loopback redirect

nodes.label: 4. PingOne signs the browser out
sub: clears an old session, so no userSessionMismatch

nodes.label: 6. Sign-in, Protect, consent
sub: the demo user; the screen names the agent

nodes.label: 9. The gateway call stops
sub: 502 on SE (backends down); locally 403, scope airlines:read missing

steps.title: 401, then register
steps.what: The agent calls /mcp with no token and gets a 401. It then registers (201).
steps.why: This is how every MCP client discovers it must sign in.

steps.title: Authorize
steps.what: The agent opens /connector/authorize with PKCE. The connector answers 302.
steps.why: The connector validated the client and the redirect.

steps.title: Sign out first
steps.what: With the sign-out option on, the 302 goes to PingOne's sign-out.
steps.why: An old PingOne session in the browser caused userSessionMismatch on the consent step.

steps.title: Back to resume
steps.what: PingOne signs the browser out and returns to /connector/resume (302).
steps.why: Resume continues to the sign-in the connector prepared; it never takes an address from the request.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.what: The user signs in at PingOne; Protect checks it and the screen names the agent.
steps.why: This is the real PingOne flow.

steps.title: Code, then token
steps.what: The connector gets the PingOne code, acts for the user, and the agent trades its code for the connector's token (200).
steps.why: The agent holds the connector's token only.

steps.title: Bearer token
steps.what: The agent calls /mcp with the token: initialize and tools/list return 200.
steps.why: Sign-in and the tool list work end to end.

steps.title: tools/call
steps.what: The tool call reaches the gateway chain and is refused: 502 through the real gateway (its backends were scaled to zero), or 403 against a local airline server (scope airlines:read missing).
steps.why: The balance needs the gateway's own token exchange, which adds airlines:read.
